text: The normal insulin and C-peptide levels rule out an insulinoma or factitious insulin administration, and the normal beta-hydroxybutyrate suggests this is not due to starvation ketosis alone. Given her history of depression with multiple suicide attempts, recent bariatric surgery, and unexplained hypoglycemia, I must consider intentional ingestion of an oral hypoglycemic agent.
